# Music and sound for shorts

**Licence-safe music, AI tracks, SFX beds and a clean -14 LUFS mix for every short — with prompts for Claudia's four clip types.**

Picks, generates, licenses and mixes music and sound for short-form video — which music each account type may legally use on TikTok (Commercial Music Library), Instagram (Meta Sound Collection) and YouTube Shorts (Audio Library, Content ID blocks on Shorts over 1 minute); AI music with Lyria and ElevenLabs Music via @useclaudia/media (terms, prompts without artist names, Suno v6 and Udio status); sound effects and ambience beds with ElevenLabs SFX; layered sound design, ducking, beat-synced cuts, -14 LUFS delivery and a licence log. Use when adding music or SFX to a short, when a post gets muted or claimed, when generating a track, or when scoring Claudia's bedroom, club, lounge and club clips.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 15–30 min per short | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-08 |

## How it works

1. Pick the licence path from the account type
2. Decide: platform sound, library track or AI track
3. Write the music brief
4. Estimate, then generate
5. Build the ambience and SFX layer
6. Cut to the beat
7. Mix in layers, duck, normalise
8. Log every track

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `music-and-sound-for-shorts.zip` (don't unzip it).
